title: update_dependency
description: Updates a package dependency to a specified version in the project's dependency manifest.

package.description: The name of the package or dependency to update (e.g. 'requests', '@org/pkg').

to_version.description: The target version string to update the dependency to (e.g. '2.28.0', '^4.0.0').

from_version.description: The current version string of the dependency before the update. Used for validation and changelog generation.
